# Linewire by Agentic Desk — Full summary

Linewire is a sports betting digest product from Agentic Desk. It delivers betting line moves (spread, total, moneyline), DFS picks and slate notes, and a personal line watchlist in one daily email. Edge adds real-time-style price alerts when a watched line hits your target number, plus steam and reverse-line-move (RLM) alerts.

## What subscribers get

### Daily digest (Signal and Edge)
1. Line moves — biggest overnight moves since open; steam and RLM called out
2. DFS picks — 3 core plays, 2 value plays, 1 fade for the main slate, plus injury/lineup notes that change ownership
3. Line watchlist — current number vs open for teams, games, and props you follow
4. One clear call — the single spot most worth attention today
5. Noise filter — what was skipped so you do not have to read it
6. Tomorrow — games and lines to watch next

### Edge-only
- Price alerts when a watchlist line moves to your set number
- Steam and reverse-line-move alerts on watched lines

Sunday CT digest for people not ready for daily Signal/Edge. Join via https://linewirehq.com/newsletter.html or the waitlist on the homepage (Formspree).

## Trust / compliance
- Public data only
- Never asks for sportsbook, bank, or financial-account passwords
- Not betting advice; informational only; 21+; gambling problem → 1-800-GAMBLER
